Select distinct molecule ChEMBL IDs (aliased as compound_chembl_id) and canonical SMILES (aliased as canonical_smiles) for compounds tested against the target named 'deoxynucleoside triphosphate triphosphohydrolase' in Homo sapiens. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, activities to assays on assay_id, and assays to target_dictionary on tid. Filter target_dictionary.pref_name for 'deoxynucleoside triphosphate triphosphohydrolase' and target_dictionary.organism (or tax_id) for Homo sapiens. Also filter assays.assay_organism for 'Homo sapiens' to restrict to assays performed on human cells. INNER JOIN compound_structures on molregno to ensure canonical_smiles is present. Deduplicate on (compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles). Sort by compound_chembl_id ascending.
